title: ActivityPub Won by Being Boring
excerpt: At FediForum 2026, ActivityPub co-author Evan Prodromou explained why the protocol succeeded by staying deliberately ordinary and why the W3C's Q3 2026 revision needs to keep it that way.
content_html:
At FediForum 2026, Evan Prodromou gave a talk with the kind of title only a protocol co-author can get away with: “How To Bullshit Your Way Through a Conversation about ActivityPub.”

The joke worked because the speaker had no need to bluff. Prodromou is one of the five authors listed on the W3C ActivityPub Recommendation and the author of O’Reilly’s ActivityPub book. The self-deprecating frame covered an honest architecture talk about why the Fediverse works at all.

His running gag was that every term could be treated as a portmanteau. Fediverse is federated plus universe. ActivityPub is activity plus publishing. RESTful, in his groaner version, is rest plus full. Fine. Protocol people deserve hobbies too.

Behind the jokes was a serious claim: ActivityPub works because its core is intentionally ordinary. It is impressive in the way a good loading dock is impressive. Trucks arrive. Boxes move. Nobody writes a poem about the forklift.

Any competent Web engineer from the mid-2010s could look at ActivityPub and think, yes, this is roughly how I would have done it.

If you want the primer before the argument, start with What Is ActivityPub?. This piece is about why those familiar parts mattered.

The protocol part is deliberately dull

Federation starts with a modest agreement. Independent networks agree to exchange activity data. They do not agree on a database, a moderation model, an admission policy, a user interface, a ranking system, or a product category.

That minimum agreement is the important part. Mastodon, PeerTube, Lemmy, WriteFreely, Pixelfed, WordPress, and small single-user servers keep their own shape. It is why our Mastodon service on C.IM, PeerTube service on P.LU, and Lemmy service on R.NF can share a social graph without becoming one product.

The ActivityPub specification describes two layers: a client-to-server API and a server-to-server federation protocol. In practice, the server-to-server part is where most Fediverse operators feel the machinery. Actors have inboxes and outboxes. Servers deliver activities to remote inboxes. Other servers fetch actor documents, objects, and collections by URL.

The model is almost aggressively plain. An activity is a sentence: subject, verb, object. Alice liked the article. Bob followed Alice. A server created a note. Someone announced a post. The thing crossing the wire is often the sentence about the content, not merely the content itself.

That distinction makes ActivityPub social. A content-sync protocol can move articles and images. A social protocol also has to move reactions, follows, blocks, shares, undo operations, and the context that makes those actions meaningful.

Prodromou’s funniest historical aside was that the activity concept traces back to 1930s Soviet activity theory, associated with psychologist Alexei Leontiev, and then wandered through user-experience research before landing in Activity Streams. The Fediverse running on repurposed Marxist psychology sounds like satire written by committee. Protocol concepts rarely arrive cleanly from first principles; they get dragged in from wherever the previous generation left useful tools.

The transport is even less exotic. ActivityPub uses HTTP. Fetch an actor’s URL to learn about the actor. POST an activity to an inbox to deliver it. The spec’s overview says the quiet part directly: inboxes and outboxes are URLs, and federation usually happens by servers posting messages to other servers’ inboxes.

Even the familiar user@domain handle is not fundamental to ActivityPub. It comes through WebFinger, a modernization of older Internet identity lookup habits. The protocol needs identifiers. Humans like handles because @[email protected] fits in a search box better than a full actor URL.

This is why ActivityPub spread. JSON-ish objects, HTTP GET, HTTP POST, URLs, collections, actors, inboxes, outboxes. None of this is dazzling. Boring is implementable.

The technical debt is less charming

Boring protocols still accumulate weird debt. ActivityPub has a good example sitting in authentication.

The Fediverse commonly uses HTTP Signatures for server-to-server request authentication. The awkward part is which HTTP Signatures. The deployed Fediverse grew around the older draft-cavage-http-signatures-12, an Internet-Draft that is now expired and archived. The IETF work later produced RFC 9421, HTTP Message Signatures, published in February 2024, with a different design.

Minimum-consensus evolution looks like this in practice: a draft is useful enough, implementers ship, the network grows, and the official standard arrives later with a different shape. Nobody can fix that by saying “the spec says” loudly at a server log.

Security has another blunt edge. ActivityPub has addressing. A to field can say which actor or collection an activity is intended for. Servers can deliver only to addressed recipients, and they can check authorization when someone fetches a private object. The ActivityPub spec explicitly allows servers to require authorization and return 403 or 404 when a request should not see a target object.

That gives the Fediverse an access-control model. It does not give it end-to-end encryption.

Content usually sits in cleartext on the instance that hosts it. Admins with database or filesystem access can read what their server stores. Backups, object storage, logs, full-text indexes, and search pipelines can widen the practical trust surface if an operator is careless.

For instance admins and self-hosters, this is the operational truth worth writing on the wall: the instance is the trust boundary.

Running your own server can shrink that boundary to infrastructure you control. Choosing someone else’s server means choosing an operator, their security practices, their backup habits, their incident response, and their judgment. That is the direct consequence of a federated publishing system without built-in end-to-end encryption.

Governance is a protocol surface

Open by default sounds clean until abuse arrives with a working DNS record.

ActivityPub lets anyone put a compatible server on the network. There is no department of the Fediverse where a new instance asks for a license. That openness is essential. It is also why defederation exists.

Defederation is the rough defense mechanism for a rough world: one server blocks another server. There is no president of the Fediverse. Blocks happen locally, sometimes coordinated through shared blocklists, public warnings, private admin channels, and community memory. Obvious abuse can trigger a fast cascade. Ambiguous cases become slow, political, and deeply human.

This is where the minimum viable agreement stops being enough. A protocol can define how to deliver a Create activity. It cannot decide which community should accept a server that has weak moderation, hostile users, a spam problem, or a different theory of speech.

The standards process has its own version of this tension. W3C consensus moves slowly because it is supposed to move together. That works when the goal is interoperability rather than speed. It becomes harder once the installed base is real.

Prodromou framed the problem clearly in the Q&A. ActivityPub still has room to be invented, but it already has more than a hundred implementations and tens of millions of users whose social graph should not be broken by a clean-sheet rewrite. Every improvement has to negotiate with existing software.

Even the language around the network carries governance history. “Social web” and “Fediverse” are technically close relatives, sometimes near-synonyms. “Fediverse” also carries the identity of the 2017 to 2022 wave: free software, open standards, LGBTQ communities, safety-conscious communities, left politics, anarchist politics, and a strong sense of “us” developed against large platforms that had already failed them.

That cultural memory affects protocol adoption. Bluesky can be bridged through Bridgy Fed. From one side, bridged Bluesky accounts may look like part of the Fediverse. From the other, the same bridge may look like ActivityPub accounts appearing in the Atmosphere.

The win condition is uncomfortable

Prodromou’s answer to “when has ActivityPub won?” was intentionally uncomfortable for some parts of the Fediverse.

Victory is not merely a thousand cozy instances, each with good local norms and a donation page that almost covers the object-storage bill. That world is valuable, but it does not change the default assumptions of the Internet.

His win condition was two or more hundred-million-user commercial networks federating over ActivityPub. Think Threads plus another large network such as LinkedIn or Snap. At that point, small independent servers could still participate as peers in the same network as the giants.

A huge commercial platform joining ActivityPub is both a validation of the standard and a threat to the culture that kept the standard alive. If the open protocol is strong enough, large platforms become participants. If it is weak, they become gravity wells.

Prodromou also pointed to large Chinese social networks as an opportunity: hundreds of millions of users, mostly disconnected from the global social web, potentially able to interconnect on their own terms through an open protocol. ActivityPub’s ambition is not to be a nicer microblogging club. It is connective tissue for social software.

The historical warning came from the late 1990s web. Dynamic web content could have gone through Java applets, controlled by Sun, or ActiveX, controlled by Microsoft. The boring outsider path was JavaScript. It took years, a lot of pain, and standards work for the open option to become the default.

The Fediverse should not assume it gets the same happy ending automatically. Large platforms can arrive with proprietary “solutions” for identity, portability, search, ranking, payments, moderation, trust, or quote posts, then try to turn deployment scale into standards authority. The open answers have to ship first.

ActivityPub’s next revision should feel anticlimactic

On January 15, 2026, W3C chartered a new Social Web Working Group chaired by Darius Kazemi. The active charter runs through January 31, 2028 and covers maintenance for ActivityPub, Activity Streams, Activity Vocabulary, WebSub, Micropub, Linked Data Notifications, Webmention, and related notes.

For ActivityPub operators, the most immediate milestones are deliberately modest. The charter lists expected completion in Q3 2026 for updated ActivityPub, Activity Streams, and Activity Vocabulary documents. Prodromou described the ActivityPub work as backward-compatible and largely editorial: clarify underspecified areas, document what existing implementations already depend on, and make the standard easier to implement without breaking the network that exists.

The current ActivityPub Recommendation is stable, but it is also a 2018 document carrying the assumptions and omissions of that moment. Common Fediverse content types and behaviors often live across ActivityStreams vocabulary, implementation practice, FEPs, project-specific extensions, and admin folklore. A maintenance revision that turns some of that into clearer text is exactly the sort of work operators notice only after fewer things fail strangely.

The same charter names LOLA as a tentative deliverable that the Working Group may adopt as a Recommendation-track specification, depending on incubation progress, implementer interest, and group consensus. LOLA is a proposal for live online account portability between ActivityPub servers at a user’s request. Its draft covers copying content, moving following relationships, notifying followers, redirects, and the trust decisions involved when one server asks another for a user’s account data.

Portability is where the boring protocol has to protect users from boring lock-in. If leaving a server means losing posts, followers, reactions, media, and social context, the Fediverse has recreated the trap with more domains in it.

After the maintenance revision, the conversation can move toward an eventual ActivityPub 2. The right model may look less like a flag day and more like HTTP evolution: old versions keep working while capable peers negotiate better behavior. Backward compatibility is how a social network avoids cutting its own graph in half.

The hard engineering ahead is not making ActivityPub cleverer. Clever protocols are easy to admire and hard to deploy. ActivityPub won because it made federation feel like ordinary Web plumbing. Now the network is growing into the parts that are less ordinary: signatures, privacy, moderation, portability, commercial scale, and standards governance under load.

The next phase should keep the machinery boring while the politics, economics, and user counts stop being small.

sentences.zh: 活动是一个句子：主语、动词、宾语。

sentences.en: Alice liked the article.
sentences.zh: 爱丽丝喜欢这篇文章。

sentences.en: Bob followed Alice.
sentences.zh: 鲍勃跟着爱丽丝。

sentences.en: A server created a note.
sentences.zh: 服务器创建了一条注释。

sentences.en: Someone announced a post.
sentences.zh: 有人宣布了一个帖子。

sentences.en: The thing crossing the wire is often the sentence about the content, not merely the content itself.
sentences.zh: 跨越界限的往往是关于内容的句子，而不仅仅是内容本身。

blocks.html_en: That distinction makes ActivityPub social. A content-sync protocol can move articles and images. A social protocol also has to move reactions, follows, blocks, shares, undo operations, and the context that makes those actions meaningful.

sentences.en: That distinction makes ActivityPub social.
sentences.zh: 这种区别使 ActivityPub 具有社交性。

sentences.en: A content-sync protocol can move articles and images.
sentences.zh: 内容同步协议可以移动文章和图像。

sentences.en: A social protocol also has to move reactions, follows, blocks, shares, undo operations, and the context that makes those actions meaningful.
sentences.zh: 社交协议还必须移动反应、关注、阻止、共享、撤消操作，以及使这些操作有意义的上下文。

blocks.html_en: Prodromou’s funniest historical aside was that the activity concept traces back to 1930s Soviet activity theory, associated with psychologist Alexei Leontiev, and then wandered through user-experience research before landing in Activity Streams. The Fediverse running on repurposed Marxist psychology sounds like satire written by committee. Protocol concepts rarely arrive cleanly from first principles; they get dragged in from wherever the previous generation left useful tools.

sentences.en: Prodromou’s funniest historical aside was that the activity concept traces back to 1930s Soviet activity theory, associated with psychologist Alexei Leontiev, and then wandered through user-experience research before landing in Activity Streams.
sentences.zh: Prodromou 最有趣的历史旁白是，活动概念可以追溯到 1930 年代的苏联活动理论，与心理学家 Alexei Leontiev 相关，然后在登陆 Activity Streams 之前进行了用户体验研究。

sentences.en: The Fediverse running on repurposed Marxist psychology sounds like satire written by committee.
sentences.zh: 以重新利用的马克思主义心理学为基础的联邦宇宙听起来像是委员会写的讽刺作品。

sentences.en: Protocol concepts rarely arrive cleanly from first principles; they get dragged in from wherever the previous generation left useful tools.
sentences.zh: 协议概念很少能从第一原则中清晰地得出；他们被从上一代人留下的有用工具中拖了出来。

blocks.html_en: The transport is even less exotic. ActivityPub uses HTTP. Fetch an actor’s URL to learn about the actor. POST an activity to an inbox to deliver it. The spec’s overview says the quiet part directly: inboxes and outboxes are URLs, and federation usually happens by servers posting messages to other servers’ inboxes.

sentences.en: The transport is even less exotic.
sentences.zh: 交通更是不那么奇特。

sentences.en: ActivityPub uses HTTP.
sentences.zh: ActivityPub 使用 HTTP。

sentences.en: Fetch an actor’s URL to learn about the actor.
sentences.zh: 获取演员的 URL 以了解该演员。

sentences.en: POST an activity to an inbox to deliver it.
sentences.zh: 将活动发布到收件箱以将其交付。

sentences.en: The spec’s overview says the quiet part directly: inboxes and outboxes are URLs, and federation usually happens by servers posting messages to other servers’ inboxes.
sentences.zh: 该规范的概述直接说明了安静的部分：收件箱和发件箱是 URL，联合通常是通过服务器将消息发布到其他服务器的收件箱来实现的。

blocks.html_en: Even the familiar user@domain handle is not fundamental to ActivityPub. It comes through WebFinger, a modernization of older Internet identity lookup habits. The protocol needs identifiers. Humans like handles because @[email protected] fits in a search box better than a full actor URL.

sentences.en: Even the familiar user@domain handle is not fundamental to ActivityPub.
sentences.zh: 即使是熟悉的 user@domain 句柄也不是 ActivityPub 的基础。

sentences.en: It comes through WebFinger, a modernization of older Internet identity lookup habits.
sentences.zh: 它来自 WebFinger，这是对旧的互联网身份查找习惯的现代化改造。

sentences.en: The protocol needs identifiers.
sentences.zh: 该协议需要标识符。

sentences.en: Humans like handles because @[email protected] fits in a search box better than a full actor URL.
sentences.zh: 人们喜欢句柄，因为 @[email protected] 比完整的演员 URL 更适合搜索框。

blocks.html_en: This is why ActivityPub spread. JSON-ish objects, HTTP GET, HTTP POST, URLs, collections, actors, inboxes, outboxes. None of this is dazzling. Boring is implementable.

sentences.en: This is why ActivityPub spread.
sentences.zh: 这就是ActivityPub传播的原因。

sentences.en: JSON-ish objects, HTTP GET, HTTP POST, URLs, collections, actors, inboxes, outboxes.
sentences.zh: JSON-ish 对象、HTTP GET、HTTP POST、URL、集合、参与者、收件箱、发件箱。

sentences.en: None of this is dazzling.
sentences.zh: 这一切都不令人眼花缭乱。

sentences.en: Boring is implementable.
sentences.zh: 无聊是可以实现的。

blocks.html_en: The technical debt is less charming

sentences.en: The technical debt is less charming
sentences.zh: 技术债没那么迷人

blocks.html_en: Boring protocols still accumulate weird debt. ActivityPub has a good example sitting in authentication.

sentences.en: Boring protocols still accumulate weird debt.
sentences.zh: 无聊的协议仍然积累着奇怪的债务。

sentences.en: ActivityPub has a good example sitting in authentication.
sentences.zh: ActivityPub 在身份验证方面有一个很好的例子。

blocks.html_en: The Fediverse commonly uses HTTP Signatures for server-to-server request authentication. The awkward part is which HTTP Signatures. The deployed Fediverse grew around the older draft-cavage-http-signatures-12, an Internet-Draft that is now expired and archived. The IETF work later produced RFC 9421, HTTP Message Signatures, published in February 2024, with a different design.

sentences.en: The Fediverse commonly uses HTTP Signatures for server-to-server request authentication.
sentences.zh: Fediverse 通常使用 HTTP 签名来进行服务器到服务器的请求身份验证。

sentences.en: The awkward part is which HTTP Signatures.
sentences.zh: 尴尬的部分是 HTTP 签名。

sentences.en: The deployed Fediverse grew around the older draft-cavage-http-signatures-12, an Internet-Draft that is now expired and archived.
sentences.zh: 部署的 Fediverse 围绕较旧的 Draft-cavage-http-signatures-12 发展，该草案是一项互联网草案，现已过期并已存档。

sentences.en: The IETF work later produced RFC 9421, HTTP Message Signatures, published in February 2024, with a different design.
sentences.zh: IETF 的工作后来产生了 RFC 9421，HTTP 消息签名，于 2024 年 2 月发布，采用了不同的设计。

blocks.html_en: Minimum-consensus evolution looks like this in practice: a draft is useful enough, implementers ship, the network grows, and the official standard arrives later with a different shape. Nobody can fix that by saying “the spec says” loudly at a server log.

sentences.en: Minimum-consensus evolution looks like this in practice: a draft is useful enough, implementers ship, the network grows, and the official standard arrives later with a different shape.
sentences.zh: 最低共识的演变在实践中看起来像这样：草案足够有用，实施者发布，网络不断发展，官方标准随后以不同的形式出现。

sentences.en: Nobody can fix that by saying “the spec says” loudly at a server log.
sentences.zh: 没有人可以通过在服务器日志中大声说出“规范说”来解决这个问题。

blocks.html_en: Security has another blunt edge. ActivityPub has addressing. A to field can say which actor or collection an activity is intended for. Servers can deliver only to addressed recipients, and they can check authorization when someone fetches a private object. The ActivityPub spec explicitly allows servers to require authorization and return 403 or 404 when a request should not see a target object.

sentences.en: Security has another blunt edge.
sentences.zh: 安全还有另一个钝器。

sentences.en: ActivityPub has addressing.
sentences.zh: ActivityPub 有寻址。

sentences.en: A to field can say which actor or collection an activity is intended for.
sentences.zh: to 字段可以说明活动的目标对象是哪个参与者或集合。

sentences.en: Servers can deliver only to addressed recipients, and they can check authorization when someone fetches a private object.
sentences.zh: 服务器只能传送给指定的收件人，并且当有人获取私有对象时，它们可以检查授权。

sentences.en: The ActivityPub spec explicitly allows servers to require authorization and return 403 or 404 when a request should not see a target object.
sentences.zh: ActivityPub 规范明确允许服务器要求授权，并在请求不应看到目标对象时返回 403 或 404。

blocks.html_en: That gives the Fediverse an access-control model. It does not give it end-to-end encryption.

sentences.en: That gives the Fediverse an access-control model.
sentences.zh: 这为 Fediverse 提供了访问控制模型。

sentences.en: It does not give it end-to-end encryption.
sentences.zh: 它不提供端到端加密。

blocks.html_en: Content usually sits in cleartext on the instance that hosts it. Admins with database or filesystem access can read what their server stores. Backups, object storage, logs, full-text indexes, and search pipelines can widen the practical trust surface if an operator is careless.

sentences.en: Content usually sits in cleartext on the instance that hosts it.
sentences.zh: 内容通常以明文形式位于托管它的实例上。

sentences.en: Admins with database or filesystem access can read what their server stores.
sentences.zh: 具有数据库或文件系统访问权限的管理员可以读取其服务器存储的内容。

sentences.en: Backups, object storage, logs, full-text indexes, and search pipelines can widen the practical trust surface if an operator is careless.
sentences.zh: 如果操作员不小心，备份、对象存储、日志、全文索引和搜索管道可能会扩大实际信任面。

blocks.html_en: For instance admins and self-hosters, this is the operational truth worth writing on the wall: the instance is the trust boundary.

sentences.en: For instance admins and self-hosters, this is the operational truth worth writing on the wall: the instance is the trust boundary.
sentences.zh: 对于管理员和自托管者来说，这是值得写在墙上的操作真理：实例是信任边界。

blocks.html_en: Running your own server can shrink that boundary to infrastructure you control. Choosing someone else’s server means choosing an operator, their security practices, their backup habits, their incident response, and their judgment. That is the direct consequence of a federated publishing system without built-in end-to-end encryption.

sentences.en: Running your own server can shrink that boundary to infrastructure you control.
sentences.zh: 运行您自己的服务器可以将边界缩小到您控制的基础设施。

sentences.en: Choosing someone else’s server means choosing an operator, their security practices, their backup habits, their incident response, and their judgment.
sentences.zh: 选择别人的服务器意味着选择运营商、他们的安全实践、他们的备份习惯、他们的事件响应和他们的判断。

sentences.en: That is the direct consequence of a federated publishing system without built-in end-to-end encryption.
sentences.zh: 这是没有内置端到端加密的联合发布系统的直接后果。

blocks.html_en: Governance is a protocol surface

sentences.en: Governance is a protocol surface
sentences.zh: 治理是一个协议面

blocks.html_en: Open by default sounds clean until abuse arrives with a working DNS record.

sentences.en: Open by default sounds clean until abuse arrives with a working DNS record.
sentences.zh: 默认情况下打开听起来很干净，直到滥用行为带着有效的 DNS 记录到来。

blocks.html_en: ActivityPub lets anyone put a compatible server on the network. There is no department of the Fediverse where a new instance asks for a license. That openness is essential. It is also why defederation exists.

sentences.en: ActivityPub lets anyone put a compatible server on the network.
sentences.zh: ActivityPub 允许任何人在网络上放置兼容的服务器。

sentences.en: There is no department of the Fediverse where a new instance asks for a license.
sentences.zh: Fediverse 没有任何部门要求新实例获得许可证。

sentences.en: That openness is essential.
sentences.zh: 这种开放性至关重要。

sentences.en: It is also why defederation exists.
sentences.zh: 这也是联盟存在的原因。

blocks.html_en: Defederation is the rough defense mechanism for a rough world: one server blocks another server. There is no president of the Fediverse. Blocks happen locally, sometimes coordinated through shared blocklists, public warnings, private admin channels, and community memory. Obvious abuse can trigger a fast cascade. Ambiguous cases become slow, political, and deeply human.

sentences.en: Defederation is the rough defense mechanism for a rough world: one server blocks another server.
sentences.zh: 联合是一个粗糙世界的粗糙防御机制：一台服务器阻止另一台服务器。

sentences.en: There is no president of the Fediverse.
sentences.zh: Fediverse 没有总裁。

sentences.en: Blocks happen locally, sometimes coordinated through shared blocklists, public warnings, private admin channels, and community memory.
sentences.zh: 封锁发生在本地，有时通过共享封锁列表、公共警告、私人管理渠道和社区记忆进行协调。

sentences.en: Obvious abuse can trigger a fast cascade.
sentences.zh: 明显的滥用行为可能会引发快速连锁反应。

sentences.en: Ambiguous cases become slow, political, and deeply human.
sentences.zh: 模棱两可的案件变得缓慢、政治化且充满人情味。

blocks.html_en: This is where the minimum viable agreement stops being enough. A protocol can define how to deliver a Create activity. It cannot decide which community should accept a server that has weak moderation, hostile users, a spam problem, or a different theory of speech.

sentences.en: This is where the minimum viable agreement stops being enough.
sentences.zh: 这就是最低可行协议不再足够的地方。

sentences.en: A protocol can define how to deliver a Create activity.
sentences.zh: 协议可以定义如何交付创建活动。

sentences.en: It cannot decide which community should accept a server that has weak moderation, hostile users, a spam problem, or a different theory of speech.
sentences.zh: 它无法决定哪个社区应该接受具有弱节制、敌对用户、垃圾邮件问题或不同言论理论的服务器。

blocks.html_en: The standards process has its own version of this tension. W3C consensus moves slowly because it is supposed to move together. That works when the goal is interoperability rather than speed. It becomes harder once the installed base is real.

sentences.en: The standards process has its own version of this tension.
sentences.zh: 标准流程对这种紧张关系有其自己的版本。

sentences.en: W3C consensus moves slowly because it is supposed to move together.
sentences.zh: W3C 共识进展缓慢，因为它应该一起进展。

sentences.en: That works when the goal is interoperability rather than speed.
sentences.zh: 当目标是互操作性而不是速度时，这种方法就有效。

sentences.en: It becomes harder once the installed base is real.
sentences.zh: 一旦安装基础真实存在，事情就会变得更加困难。

blocks.html_en: Prodromou framed the problem clearly in the Q&A. ActivityPub still has room to be invented, but it already has more than a hundred implementations and tens of millions of users whose social graph should not be broken by a clean-sheet rewrite. Every improvement has to negotiate with existing software.

sentences.en: Prodromou framed the problem clearly in the Q&A.
sentences.zh: 普罗德罗穆在问答中清楚地阐述了这个问题。

sentences.en: ActivityPub still has room to be invented, but it already has more than a hundred implementations and tens of millions of users whose social graph should not be broken by a clean-sheet rewrite.
sentences.zh: ActivityPub 仍有待发明的空间，但它已经拥有一百多个实现和数千万用户，其社交图谱不应被彻底重写所破坏。

sentences.en: Every improvement has to negotiate with existing software.
sentences.zh: 每一项改进都必须与现有软件协商。

blocks.html_en: Even the language around the network carries governance history. “Social web” and “Fediverse” are technically close relatives, sometimes near-synonyms. “Fediverse” also carries the identity of the 2017 to 2022 wave: free software, open standards, LGBTQ communities, safety-conscious communities, left politics, anarchist politics, and a strong sense of “us” developed against large platforms that had already failed them.

sentences.en: Even the language around the network carries governance history.
sentences.zh: 甚至网络上的语言也承载着治理历史。

sentences.en: “Social web” and “Fediverse” are technically close relatives, sometimes near-synonyms.
sentences.zh: “社交网络”和“Fediverse”在技术上是近亲，有时甚至是同义词。

sentences.en: “Fediverse” also carries the identity of the 2017 to 2022 wave: free software, open standards, LGBTQ communities, safety-conscious communities, left politics, anarchist politics, and a strong sense of “us” developed against large platforms that had already failed them.
sentences.zh: “Fediverse”还承载着 2017 年至 2022 年浪潮的特征：自由软件、开放标准、LGBTQ 社区、安全意识社区、左翼政治、无政府主义政治，以及针对已经失败的大型平台而形成的强烈“我们”意识。

blocks.html_en: That cultural memory affects protocol adoption. Bluesky can be bridged through Bridgy Fed. From one side, bridged Bluesky accounts may look like part of the Fediverse. From the other, the same bridge may look like ActivityPub accounts appearing in the Atmosphere.

sentences.en: That cultural memory affects protocol adoption.
sentences.zh: 这种文化记忆会影响协议的采用。

sentences.en: Bluesky can be bridged through Bridgy Fed.
sentences.zh: Bluesky 可以通过 Bridgy Fed 桥接。

sentences.en: From one side, bridged Bluesky accounts may look like part of the Fediverse.
sentences.zh: 从一方面来看，桥接的 Bluesky 账户可能看起来像是 Fediverse 的一部分。

sentences.en: From the other, the same bridge may look like ActivityPub accounts appearing in the Atmosphere.
sentences.zh: 从另一个角度来看，同一桥可能看起来像 Atmosphere 中出现的 ActivityPub 帐户。

blocks.html_en: The win condition is uncomfortable

sentences.en: The win condition is uncomfortable
sentences.zh: 获胜条件不舒服

blocks.html_en: Prodromou’s answer to “when has ActivityPub won?” was intentionally uncomfortable for some parts of the Fediverse.

sentences.en: Prodromou’s answer to “when has ActivityPub won?”
sentences.zh: 普罗德罗穆对“ActivityPub 什么时候赢了？”的回答

sentences.en: was intentionally uncomfortable for some parts of the Fediverse.
sentences.zh: 故意让联邦宇宙的某些部分感到不舒服。

blocks.html_en: Victory is not merely a thousand cozy instances, each with good local norms and a donation page that almost covers the object-storage bill. That world is valuable, but it does not change the default assumptions of the Internet.

sentences.en: Victory is not merely a thousand cozy instances, each with good local norms and a donation page that almost covers the object-storage bill.
sentences.zh: 胜利不仅仅是一千个舒适的实例，每个实例都有良好的本地规范和一个几乎涵盖对象存储费用的捐赠页面。

sentences.en: That world is valuable, but it does not change the default assumptions of the Internet.
sentences.zh: 那个世界很有价值，但它并没有改变互联网的默认假设。

blocks.html_en: His win condition was two or more hundred-million-user commercial networks federating over ActivityPub. Think Threads plus another large network such as LinkedIn or Snap. At that point, small independent servers could still participate as peers in the same network as the giants.

sentences.en: His win condition was two or more hundred-million-user commercial networks federating over ActivityPub.
sentences.zh: 他的获胜条件是两个或更多拥有数亿用户的商业网络通过 ActivityPub 联合起来。

sentences.en: Think Threads plus another large network such as LinkedIn or Snap.
sentences.zh: 想想 Threads 加上另一个大型网络，例如 LinkedIn 或 Snap。

sentences.en: At that point, small independent servers could still participate as peers in the same network as the giants.
sentences.zh: 那时，小型独立服务器仍然可以作为对等体参与与巨头相同的网络。

blocks.html_en: A huge commercial platform joining ActivityPub is both a validation of the standard and a threat to the culture that kept the standard alive. If the open protocol is strong enough, large platforms become participants. If it is weak, they become gravity wells.

sentences.en: A huge commercial platform joining ActivityPub is both a validation of the standard and a threat to the culture that kept the standard alive.
sentences.zh: 一个巨大的商业平台加入 ActivityPub 既是对标准的验证，也是对保持标准活力的文化的威胁。

sentences.en: If the open protocol is strong enough, large platforms become participants.
sentences.zh: 如果开放协议足够强大，大型平台就会成为参与者。

sentences.en: If it is weak, they become gravity wells.
sentences.zh: 如果它很弱，它们就会变成重力井。

blocks.html_en: Prodromou also pointed to large Chinese social networks as an opportunity: hundreds of millions of users, mostly disconnected from the global social web, potentially able to interconnect on their own terms through an open protocol. ActivityPub’s ambition is not to be a nicer microblogging club. It is connective tissue for social software.

sentences.en: Prodromou also pointed to large Chinese social networks as an opportunity: hundreds of millions of users, mostly disconnected from the global social web, potentially able to interconnect on their own terms through an open protocol.
sentences.zh: 普罗德罗穆还指出，中国的大型社交网络是一个机会：数亿用户，大部分与全球社交网络断开连接，有可能通过开放协议按照自己的方式互连。

sentences.en: ActivityPub’s ambition is not to be a nicer microblogging club.
sentences.zh: ActivityPub 的目标并不是成为一个更好的微博俱乐部。

sentences.en: It is connective tissue for social software.
sentences.zh: 它是社交软件的结缔组织。

blocks.html_en: The historical warning came from the late 1990s web. Dynamic web content could have gone through Java applets, controlled by Sun, or ActiveX, controlled by Microsoft. The boring outsider path was JavaScript. It took years, a lot of pain, and standards work for the open option to become the default.

sentences.en: The historical warning came from the late 1990s web.
sentences.zh: 历史警告来自 20 世纪 90 年代末的网络。

sentences.en: Dynamic web content could have gone through Java applets, controlled by Sun, or ActiveX, controlled by Microsoft.
sentences.zh: 动态 Web 内容可以通过由 Sun 控制的 Java applet 或由 Microsoft 控制的 ActiveX。

sentences.en: The boring outsider path was JavaScript.
sentences.zh: 无聊的局外人路径是 JavaScript。

sentences.en: It took years, a lot of pain, and standards work for the open option to become the default.
sentences.zh: 经过多年的努力和标准的制定，开放选项才成为默认选项。

blocks.html_en: The Fediverse should not assume it gets the same happy ending automatically. Large platforms can arrive with proprietary “solutions” for identity, portability, search, ranking, payments, moderation, trust, or quote posts, then try to turn deployment scale into standards authority. The open answers have to ship first.

sentences.en: The Fediverse should not assume it gets the same happy ending automatically.
sentences.zh: Fediverse 不应该假设它会自动获得同样的幸福结局。

sentences.en: Large platforms can arrive with proprietary “solutions” for identity, portability, search, ranking, payments, moderation, trust, or quote posts, then try to turn deployment scale into standards authority.
sentences.zh: 大型平台可以提供身份、可移植性、搜索、排名、支付、审核、信任或引用帖子的专有“解决方案”，然后尝试将部署规模转变为标准权威。

sentences.en: The open answers have to ship first.
sentences.zh: 开放的答案必须首先发布。

blocks.html_en: ActivityPub’s next revision should feel anticlimactic

sentences.en: ActivityPub’s next revision should feel anticlimactic
sentences.zh: ActivityPub 的下一次修订应该会让人感觉虎头蛇尾

blocks.html_en: On January 15, 2026, W3C chartered a new Social Web Working Group chaired by Darius Kazemi. The active charter runs through January 31, 2028 and covers maintenance for ActivityPub, Activity Streams, Activity Vocabulary, WebSub, Micropub, Linked Data Notifications, Webmention, and related notes.

sentences.en: On January 15, 2026, W3C chartered a new Social Web Working Group chaired by Darius Kazemi.
sentences.zh: 2026 年 1 月 15 日，W3C 成立了一个新的社交网络工作组，由 Darius Kazemi 担任主席。

content_html_zh:
在 FediForum 2026 上，Evan Prodromou 发表了一场演讲，其标题只有协议共同作者才能逃脱：“如何通过关于 ActivityPub 的对话来胡说八道。”

这个笑话之所以有效，是因为说话者没有必要虚张声势。 Prodromou 是 W3C ActivityPub 推荐名单上列出的五位作者之一，也是 O’Reilly 的 ActivityPub 书的作者。 这个自嘲的框架涵盖了一个诚实的架构谈论为什么 Fediverse 会起作用。

他一贯的玩笑是，每个术语都可以被视为一个组合词。 Fediverse 是联邦加宇宙。 ActivityPub 是活动加发布。 RESTful，用他的抱怨版本来说，就是休息加上充实。 美好的。 礼仪人士也应该有爱好。

这些笑话的背后是一个严肃的主张：ActivityPub 之所以能成功，是因为它的核心故意是普通的。 它令人印象深刻，就像一个好的装卸码头令人印象深刻一样。 卡车到达。 盒子移动。 没有人写一首关于叉车的诗。

2010 年代中期任何有能力的 Web 工程师都可以在查看 ActivityPub 后想，是的，我大概会这样做。

如果您想在论证之前先了解入门知识，请从什么是 ActivityPub？ 开始。 这篇文章是关于为什么那些熟悉的部分很重要。

协议部分故意显得乏味

联盟以一份适度的协议开始。 独立网络同意交换活动数据。 他们在数据库、审核模型、准入政策、用户界面、排名系统或产品类别方面没有达成一致。

最低限度的协议是重要的部分。 Mastodon、PeerTube、Lemmy、WriteFreely、Pixelfed、WordPress 和小型单用户服务器保持自己的形状。 这就是为什么我们在 C.IM 上的 Mastodon 服务、P.LU 上的 PeerTube 服务和 R.NF 上的 Lemmy 服务可以共享社交图谱而不成为一个产品。

ActivityPub 规范描述了两层：客户端到服务器 API 和服务器到服务器联合协议。 实际上，服务器到服务器部分是大多数 Fediverse 操作员感受到机器的地方。 演员有收件箱和发件箱。 服务器将活动传送到远程收件箱。 其他服务器通过 URL 获取参与者文档、对象和集合。

该模型几乎非常简单。 活动是一个句子：主语、动词、宾语。 爱丽丝喜欢这篇文章。 鲍勃跟着爱丽丝。 服务器创建了一条注释。 有人宣布了一个帖子。 跨越界限的往往是关于内容的句子，而不仅仅是内容本身。

这种区别使 ActivityPub 具有社交性。 内容同步协议可以移动文章和图像。 社交协议还必须移动反应、关注、阻止、共享、撤消操作，以及使这些操作有意义的上下文。

Prodromou 最有趣的历史旁白是，活动概念可以追溯到 1930 年代的苏联活动理论，与心理学家 Alexei Leontiev 相关，然后在登陆 Activity Streams 之前进行了用户体验研究。 以重新利用的马克思主义心理学为基础的联邦宇宙听起来像是委员会写的讽刺作品。 协议概念很少能从第一原则中清晰地得出；他们被从上一代人留下的有用工具中拖了出来。

交通更是不那么奇特。 ActivityPub 使用 HTTP。 获取演员的 URL 以了解该演员。 将活动发布到收件箱以将其交付。 该规范的概述直接说明了安静的部分：收件箱和发件箱是 URL，联合通常是通过服务器将消息发布到其他服务器的收件箱来实现的。

即使是熟悉的 user@domain 句柄也不是 ActivityPub 的基础。 它来自 WebFinger，这是对旧的互联网身份查找习惯的现代化改造。 该协议需要标识符。 人们喜欢句柄，因为 @[email protected] 比完整的演员 URL 更适合搜索框。

这就是ActivityPub传播的原因。 JSON-ish 对象、HTTP GET、HTTP POST、URL、集合、参与者、收件箱、发件箱。 这一切都不令人眼花缭乱。 无聊是可以实现的。

技术债没那么迷人

无聊的协议仍然积累着奇怪的债务。 ActivityPub 在身份验证方面有一个很好的例子。

Fediverse 通常使用 HTTP 签名来进行服务器到服务器的请求身份验证。 尴尬的部分是 HTTP 签名。 部署的 Fediverse 围绕较旧的 Draft-cavage-http-signatures-12 发展，该草案是一项互联网草案，现已过期并已存档。 IETF 的工作后来产生了 RFC 9421，HTTP 消息签名，于 2024 年 2 月发布，采用了不同的设计。

最低共识的演变在实践中看起来像这样：草案足够有用，实施者发布，网络不断发展，官方标准随后以不同的形式出现。 没有人可以通过在服务器日志中大声说出“规范说”来解决这个问题。

安全还有另一个钝器。 ActivityPub 有寻址。 to 字段可以说明活动的目标对象是哪个参与者或集合。 服务器只能传送给指定的收件人，并且当有人获取私有对象时，它们可以检查授权。 ActivityPub 规范明确允许服务器要求授权，并在请求不应看到目标对象时返回 403 或 404。

这为 Fediverse 提供了访问控制模型。 它不提供端到端加密。

内容通常以明文形式位于托管它的实例上。 具有数据库或文件系统访问权限的管理员可以读取其服务器存储的内容。 如果操作员不小心，备份、对象存储、日志、全文索引和搜索管道可能会扩大实际信任面。

对于管理员和自托管者来说，这是值得写在墙上的操作真理：实例是信任边界。

运行您自己的服务器可以将边界缩小到您控制的基础设施。 选择别人的服务器意味着选择运营商、他们的安全实践、他们的备份习惯、他们的事件响应和他们的判断。 这是没有内置端到端加密的联合发布系统的直接后果。

治理是一个协议面

默认情况下打开听起来很干净，直到滥用行为带着有效的 DNS 记录到来。

ActivityPub 允许任何人在网络上放置兼容的服务器。 Fediverse 没有任何部门要求新实例获得许可证。 这种开放性至关重要。 这也是联盟存在的原因。

联合是一个粗糙世界的粗糙防御机制：一台服务器阻止另一台服务器。 Fediverse 没有总裁。 封锁发生在本地，有时通过共享封锁列表、公共警告、私人管理渠道和社区记忆进行协调。 明显的滥用行为可能会引发快速连锁反应。 模棱两可的案件变得缓慢、政治化且充满人情味。

这就是最低可行协议不再足够的地方。 协议可以定义如何交付创建活动。 它无法决定哪个社区应该接受具有弱节制、敌对用户、垃圾邮件问题或不同言论理论的服务器。

标准流程对这种紧张关系有其自己的版本。 W3C 共识进展缓慢，因为它应该一起进展。 当目标是互操作性而不是速度时，这种方法就有效。 一旦安装基础真实存在，事情就会变得更加困难。

普罗德罗穆在问答中清楚地阐述了这个问题。 ActivityPub 仍有待发明的空间，但它已经拥有一百多个实现和数千万用户，其社交图谱不应被彻底重写所破坏。 每一项改进都必须与现有软件协商。

甚至网络上的语言也承载着治理历史。 “社交网络”和“Fediverse”在技术上是近亲，有时甚至是同义词。 “Fediverse”还承载着 2017 年至 2022 年浪潮的特征：自由软件、开放标准、LGBTQ 社区、安全意识社区、左翼政治、无政府主义政治，以及针对已经失败的大型平台而形成的强烈“我们”意识。

这种文化记忆会影响协议的采用。 Bluesky 可以通过 Bridgy Fed 桥接。 从一方面来看，桥接的 Bluesky 账户可能看起来像是 Fediverse 的一部分。 从另一个角度来看，同一桥可能看起来像 Atmosphere 中出现的 ActivityPub 帐户。

获胜条件不舒服

普罗德罗穆对“ActivityPub 什么时候赢了？”的回答 故意让联邦宇宙的某些部分感到不舒服。

胜利不仅仅是一千个舒适的实例，每个实例都有良好的本地规范和一个几乎涵盖对象存储费用的捐赠页面。 那个世界很有价值，但它并没有改变互联网的默认假设。

他的获胜条件是两个或更多拥有数亿用户的商业网络通过 ActivityPub 联合起来。 想想 Threads 加上另一个大型网络，例如 LinkedIn 或 Snap。 那时，小型独立服务器仍然可以作为对等体参与与巨头相同的网络。

一个巨大的商业平台加入 ActivityPub 既是对标准的验证，也是对保持标准活力的文化的威胁。 如果开放协议足够强大，大型平台就会成为参与者。 如果它很弱，它们就会变成重力井。

普罗德罗穆还指出，中国的大型社交网络是一个机会：数亿用户，大部分与全球社交网络断开连接，有可能通过开放协议按照自己的方式互连。 ActivityPub 的目标并不是成为一个更好的微博俱乐部。 它是社交软件的结缔组织。

历史警告来自 20 世纪 90 年代末的网络。 动态 Web 内容可以通过由 Sun 控制的 Java applet 或由 Microsoft 控制的 ActiveX。 无聊的局外人路径是 JavaScript。 经过多年的努力和标准的制定，开放选项才成为默认选项。

Fediverse 不应该假设它会自动获得同样的幸福结局。 大型平台可以提供身份、可移植性、搜索、排名、支付、审核、信任或引用帖子的专有“解决方案”，然后尝试将部署规模转变为标准权威。 开放的答案必须首先发布。

ActivityPub 的下一次修订应该会让人感觉虎头蛇尾

2026 年 1 月 15 日，W3C 成立了一个新的社交网络工作组，由 Darius Kazemi 担任主席。 有效章程有效期至 2028 年 1 月 31 日，涵盖 ActivityPub、Activity Streams、Activity Vocabulary、WebSub、Micropub、链接数据通知、Webmention 和相关注释的维护。

对于 ActivityPub 运营商来说，最直接的里程碑是刻意低调的。 该章程列出了更新后的 ActivityPub、Activity Streams 和 Activity Vocabulary 文档的预期完成时间为 2026 年第三季度。 Prodromou 将 ActivityPub 的工作描述为向后兼容且主要是编辑性的：澄清未指定的领域，记录现有实现已经依赖的内容，并在不破坏现有网络的情况下使标准更容易实现。

目前的 ActivityPub 建议是稳定的，但它也是 2018 年的文件，包含当时的假设和遗漏。 常见的 Fediverse 内容类型和行为通常存在于 ActivityStreams 词汇、实施实践、FEP、特定于项目的扩展和管理民间传说中。 维护修订将其中一些内容转换为更清晰的文本，这正是操作员只有在更少的奇怪故障之后才会注意到的工作。

同一章程将 LOLA 命名为暂定可交付成果，工作组可以根据孵化进度、实施者兴趣和小组共识将其采纳为推荐轨道规范。 LOLA 是一项根据用户请求在 ActivityPub 服务器之间实现实时在线帐户可移植性的提案。 它的草案涵盖了复制内容、移动关注关系、通知关注者、重定向以及当一台服务器向另一台服务器请求用户帐户数据时所涉及的信任决策。

可移植性是无聊协议必须保护用户免受无聊锁定的地方。 如果离开服务器意味着失去帖子、关注者、反应、媒体和社交环境，那么 Fediverse 就用更多的域重新创造了这个陷阱。

维护修订后，对话可以转向最终的 ActivityPub 2。 正确的模型可能看起来不像是一个标志日，而更像是 HTTP 的演变：旧版本继续工作，而有能力的同行协商更好的行为。 向后兼容性是社交网络避免将自己的图切成两半的方法。

未来的艰苦工程并没有让 ActivityPub 变得更聪明。 聪明的协议很容易欣赏，但很难部署。 ActivityPub 获胜是因为它让联邦感觉就像普通的 Web 管道。 现在，网络正在发展到不那么普通的部分：签名、隐私、审核、可移植性、商业规模和负载下的标准治理。

下一阶段应该让机器变得无聊，同时政治、经济和用户数量不再减少。

观看演讲

FediForum 的录音值得一看，因为其中的笑话使架构更容易记住。
